Adriatic Sea demersal fisheries system (draft)

Source: R/presets.R
adriatic_system_draft.Rd

Draft, indicative only. The demersal fisheries of the Adriatic Sea (GFCM geographical subareas 17 and 18) under the multiannual management plan (Recommendation GFCM/43/2019/5):

Usage

adriatic_system_draft()

Value

An ms_system.

Details

  • ten stocks: European hake, red mullet, common sole, deep-water rose shrimp (Adriatic part of GSAs 17-20) and Norway lobster in four functional units (17C Pomo, 17NW, 17NE, 18), the key stocks of the plan (plan = 1; the Norway lobster units share the management unit NEP), plus spottail mantis shrimp and common cuttlefish (assessed, not in the plan);

  • five areas: western (Italian) and eastern (Croatian) GSA 17, the Jabuka/Pomo Pits, the GSA 18 shelf and the upper slope of the South Adriatic Pit;

  • twelve metiers in five segments: bottom otter trawl (five grounds), beam trawl "rapido" for sole, gillnets/trammel nets/pots/creels, and bottom longlines in GSA 18 (deep) and eastern GSA 17. Trawl and beam trawl are regulated by the plan's effort regime (segment plan = 1).

r and K, catches by fleet and the latest status (B/Btarget, F/Ftarget, reference years 2023-2024) come from GFCM stock assessments (WGSAD 2024, SRC-AS 2025, stock assessment forms and benchmarks); the distribution of stocks across areas follows Panzeri et al. (2024, Fish and Fisheries 25:187-204). Catchability is the catch per day relative to biomass; daily costs by metier and catchability by stock were calibrated so that the status quo reproduces the observed days by metier and the assessed F/Fmsy. Projections can start from the assessed biomass (dep_now, see ms_start()). The build script is data-raw/adriatic_build.R in the source repository; adriatic_catch.csv and adriatic_distribution.csv in extdata hold the catches by metier and the distribution by area.

Examples

sys <- adriatic_system_draft()
sys$capacity
#>        OTB   TBB_sole    gillnet LLS_18deep    LLS_17E 
#>     150000       7000      72000      20000      25000
